experiment: E007 — Hidden speed (WR): tracked top-end speed beyond the 40 time

implementation_choices.choice: Combine position WR and TE; player_play rows with route_ran non-null in games with season_type REG. All 43,162 such rows have play_nullified_by_penalty = 'N' (asserted), so no penalty filter. Routes on sacks, scrambles and throwaways (pass_result S/R/IN) are routes run and are kept.
implementation_choices.why: Prereg/brief population; 'routes run' conventionally counts every dropback route.

implementation_choices.choice: 100 - yardline_number when yardline_side == possession_team, yardline_number otherwise; yardline_side is null only at the 50 (571 rows, all yardline_number 50) -> 50.
implementation_choices.why: Direct reading of the field-position fields; checked on the data before any modelling.

implementation_choices.choice: defense = the games.csv team (home/visitor) that is not possession_team; score_diff = possession team's pre-snap score minus the opponent's; defense team-season = '<team>_<season>' (96 levels).

Categorical (native HGB categories): lined_up_position, receiver_alignment, offense_formation, in_motion_at_ball_snap, team_coverage_man_zone, season, defense_team_season. Numeric: down, yards_to_go, yards_to_end_zone, quarter (OT = 5), score_diff. Nulls are HGB's missing value. Category codes = rank of the label among sorted labels (outcome-free).
implementation_choices.why: Labels with no natural order are categorical; down/distance/field/quarter/score are ordered quantities.

implementation_choices.choice: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(categorical_features=<7 categorical columns>, random_state=0), all other hyperparameters default (incl. early_stopping='auto', which is active here because each training fold has > 10,000 rows: 10% of the training fold is held out at random, fixed by random_state). GroupKFold(n_splits=5) by game_id with sklearn defaults (no shuffle). P2 model trained on all WR+TE routes with non-null cushion; P3 model on all WR+TE routes with rec_yards null -> 0. residual = observed - out-of-fold prediction.
implementation_choices.why: Brief: default hyperparameters, fixed random_state, cross-fitted by game on all study WR+TE routes.

implementation_choices.choice: Deep-route share and targets per route: HistGradientBoostingClassifier with the same context, categories, folds and random_state; expectation = out-of-fold P(event); EB with shrinkage.eb_rate (cluster='game_id', min_n=100 routes, as P3).
implementation_choices.why: eb_rate needs per-play probabilities in (0, 1); a squared-error regressor can leave that range.

implementation_choices.choice: shrinkage.eb_mean(WR rows only, cluster='game_id', min_n=50 (P2) / 100 (P3)); target = `shrunk`. The prior is fitted on the kept WRs, including WRs without a tracked 40.
implementation_choices.why: Prereg + amendment (game-clustered sampling variance); 'prior estimated on eligible players'.

implementation_choices.choice: reliability.split_half_estimator on Combine WRs with >= 50 REG plays: odd vs even games (dense rank), estimator = q95 of play max speed (plays <= 12 yd/s, polars 'nearest' quantile as in features.game_top_speed), NaN if a half has < 25 plays; Pearson, Spearman-Brown.
implementation_choices.why: Same estimator as the target; 25 = half the target's 50-play minimum.

implementation_choices.choice: split-half = shrinkage.check_prior's split-half (odd/even games, kept WRs, Spearman-Brown); half-difference diagnostic (targets_wr.half_difference): the same EB estimator refit on odd and even games, mean z2 = (raw0 - raw1)^2 / (se0^2 + se1^2) with SE (expected 1 when sampling variances are right), halves need >= 10 routes; team_share with team_col = [team_abbr, season] on WR routes; exposure = corr(shrunk target, log routes) over kept WRs.
implementation_choices.why: Brief; the half-difference check was asked for after the OL pressure target looked under-dispersed.

implementation_choices.choice: speed.attempt_icc on WR attempts (centered within draft year), `reliability` column (Spearman-Brown for each player's number of attempts, averaged).
implementation_choices.why: Reliability of the player-level feature as used.

implementation_choices.choice: Seed stability = criteria 1-3 hold at each of seeds 0, 1, 2. Leave-3-out = drop the 3 WRs with the largest positive products of B2-residualized feature and target (linkage.partial_residuals, i.e. the largest positive contributions to the partial correlation), rerun with the full harness at seed 0; passes if the one-sided Freedman-Lane p < 0.05 with the expected sign.
implementation_choices.why: PLAN.md §4 criterion 6 made operational before results.

implementation_choices.choice: Benjamini-Hochberg over the seed-0 one-sided Freedman-Lane p of P1-P3 (criterion 4). Also reported: BH over every distinct E007 test (primaries + every robustness variant except seed replicates + exploratory).
Same player targets (EB priors fitted with all eligible WRs); 2025 draftees dropped before evaluate.
implementation_choices.why: Isolates the 2025 one-season class without changing target definitions.

implementation_choices.choice: P1 = game_top_speed; P2/P3 from eb_mean(..., group='position') on WR+TE routes (one prior per position; the WR values equal the WR-only fit, asserted); the harness adds the position dummy.

c40_smax (brief's 'raw tracked peak speed'), c40_vmax (fitted vmax), c40_v_30_40 (flying 10), each vs P1-P3; plus the literal E001 feature (combine_top_speed = max device `s` over 40 attempts) because the prereg wording names it.
implementation_choices.why: Prereg + brief; c40_smax and the E001 feature differ slightly (SG interior peak, QC-passing mean vs raw max).

implementation_choices.choice: P1: S0 from speed.game_as_profiles (AS_K = 50, AS_R = 1000, seed 0) on WR post-snap REG frames. P2: cushion minus its lined_up_position mean (over all WR+TE cushion routes), eb_mean min_n 50, cluster game. P3: rec_yards0 (raw yards per route), eb_mean min_n 100, cluster game.
implementation_choices.why: Prereg; 'alignment' = the receiver's own alignment (lined_up_position: WR / SLOT_WR / TE ...), since receiver_alignment describes the whole formation (2x2, 3x1).

implementation_choices.choice: (E1) deep-route share over expected: route in {GO, POST, CORNER}; (E2) average depth of target: pass_length on the WR's targeted routes, raw, eb_mean min_n 20 targets, cluster game; (E3) targets per route over expected; (E4) DB analog: c40_v_20_40 -> DB game_top_speed; (E5) career offensive snaps per available season = career_offensive_snaps / (2026 - draft_year), all Combine WRs with a tracked 40. Harness n_repeats 20, n_perm 500, n_perm_fl 2000, seed 0.
implementation_choices.why: Prelisted in the prereg; the details were left open and fixed here.

implementation_choices.choice: Combine WRs with a tracked 40 and an official forty: center c40_v_20_40 and forty within draft year (WR means), OLS of centered flying-20 on centered forty, hidden speed = residual (yd/s; mph = x 3600/1760). Rank 1 = largest. Top quintile = hidden speed >= its 80th percentile. Late = draft round > 3 or undrafted.

Among WRs with a tracked 40, an official forty and >= 50 tracked REG plays: pairs with |delta forty| <= 0.01 s (widened to 0.02 / 0.03 only if none), pick the pair with the largest |delta hidden speed|. Uses Combine data only.
implementation_choices.why: Avoids choosing an illustrative pair by its game outcome.

feature.name: c40_v_20_40
feature.definition: tracked 40: 20 / (t40 - t20) from the official 20- and 40-yd lines, mean over QC-passing attempts (bdb27.speed)

warnings: EB prior disagrees with split-half reliability: implied 0.74, split-half 0.87 [0.78, 0.92]
EB prior disagrees with split-half reliability: implied 0.76, split-half 0.88 [0.80, 0.93]

criteria.7_scout_sentence: Two receivers with the same 40 time: the one who is faster from the 20 to the 40 is faster in games.
Corners play off a receiver whose late-sprint speed is better than his 40 time says.
A receiver whose late-sprint speed beats his 40 time produces more yards per route than his usage predicts.

post_hoc.note: Added after the primary, robustness and exploratory results were seen. Not claims.

post_hoc_review.note: Added after the two-skeptic review of all results above. Sensitivity analyses and diagnostics of the preregistered results; not claims; in no BH family. Tests use expected sign + and the PH harness.

definitions.receiver_depth: line of scrimmage x (110 - yards_to_end_zone) minus the receiver's standardized x at the ball_snap frame (yd; positive = off the line)
definitions.receiver_sideline: min(y, 53.33 - y) at the ball_snap frame (yd)
definitions.cushion_oe_align: cushion minus a cross-fitted expectation from the prereg context plus receiver depth and sideline distance (same HGB, folds and random_state), eb_mean WR min_n 50 cluster game
definitions.off_epa: route-weighted mean EPA of the receiver's team-season REG dropbacks in player_play, excluding the dropbacks on which he was targeted (off_epa_incl keeps them)
definitions.qb_epa: route-weighted mean EPA of the parsed passer x team-season's dropbacks without the receiver's own targets (>= 50), null otherwise (imputed with an indicator by the harness)
definitions.deep_share / slot_share: share of the receiver's REG routes that are GO/POST/CORNER / lined up SLOT_WR
definitions.rec_yards_per_season / log_routes_per_se: REG receiving yards (routes) / (2026 - draft_year), 0 if none, all Combine WRs with a tracked 40
definitions.reverse_leave_3_out: drop the 3 most negative x_res * y_res contributions (criterion 6b drops the most positive), rerun
definitions.bootstrap: 2,000 player resamples (seed 0), re-imputed and re-residualized on B2, percentile interval

S0_provenance.note: The E007 feature is, beyond B2, the same variable as the E006 skeptic's post hoc flying split, which was chosen after it absorbed the vmax -> S0 signal on these WRs (prereg 'already_seen' item 2). The S0 target variant is therefore a re-observation of a known post hoc association, not new evidence; its q-values carry no confirmatory weight, and a new prereg on the same WRs cannot change that.

cushion_semantics.reading: cushion is the receiver-to-(aligned)-defender distance at the snap, so it contains the receiver's own depth off the line and split, which the prereg context does not include.

bh_all_tests.family: every prespecified E007 test (primaries at seed 0, robustness except seed replicates, exploratory); post hoc tests are in no family
bh_all_tests.note_S0: target_variant/P1_S0 re-observes the E006 post hoc vmax/flying-split -> S0 association on the same WRs (see post_hoc_review.S0_provenance); its q is not confirmatory evidence.

post_hoc_official_splits.note: The tracked component beyond the 40 is not corroborated by the official electronic 10-yd split, and the 20-yd split clubs receive is not in the data. 'Beyond the official 40', not 'beyond the stopwatch'.

post_hoc_all_matched_pairs.note: post hoc; same WRs and target as P1, so not independent of the P1 test
